x: For Belgrave, as the Israeli Ladany speeds across Westminster Bridge at 8 minute mile speed, Ray Middleton new to the distance but likely to set a new club record beating Ray Hall's 7Hrs 58 Mins 33 Secs.

A fine walk by Ray Middleton who finished second to the Israeli Ladany and also a sub 6 Hour clocking from Dave DeBondi, certainly his finest race in this country, gave Belgrave an easy team victory over Surrey Walking Club.

Ray Middleton ensured that the 1970's began on a high note for the Club when he became the fastest ever Belgravian over the historic Brighton course by clocking 7hrs. 50mins. 47secs. when finishing 2nd to Shaul Ladany (Israel).

In 1970 he won the Hastings to Brighton and when finishing second to Shaul Ladany (Israel) in the London to Brighton established a new Club Record of 7h.50m.47s. for the 53 miles journey from Big Ben to Brighton seafront.
